An optional in-container browser for captcha-gated hosters (off by default), plus a fix for a black-screen bug. Just **force update**; your `/config` is untouched.

## Added
- **Opt-in "solve captcha in browser" (`JD_ENABLE_BROWSER`).** Some hosters gate downloads behind reCAPTCHA/hCaptcha/Turnstile that JDownloader can't auto-solve. Set `JD_ENABLE_BROWSER=true` and those captchas open in a bundled **Firefox** (with **uBlock Origin**) right on the web desktop, solved with one click — and from the container's own IP, which matters because those tokens are IP-bound. The Firefox profile persists in `/config/.config/mozilla`, so Cloudflare cookies survive restarts. **Off by default:** with the switch off, no browser process ever runs and nothing is wired up — only the on-disk size changes. Classic image captchas are still auto-solved either way, so most setups never need this. (Firefox work from community PR #2 by @ahmed-abdelrazek, reworked here as an opt-in so the default image stays lean.)

## Fixed
- **Opening Help → About no longer blanks the desktop.** The theme agent watches for JDownloader's "restart to apply the look and feel" prompt and confirms it. But the About dialog also lists the active look-and-feel by name, so the agent mistook it for that prompt, found no restart button, and asked the container to restart JDownloader — turning the screen black every time you opened About. The agent now requires an actual restart/apply intent in the dialog and never touches an About-type window. (Independent bugfix from community PR #2 by @ahmed-abdelrazek.)
